name: editable-cell
title: Editable cell
description: A table cell that edits in place like a spreadsheet: Enter to edit, Enter to save, Escape to cancel, with validation and a saving state.
docs: Put it in a TableCell with a value, a label and onCommit. Return a promise from onCommit to show the saving state; reject with an Error whose message is written for people, and the old value comes back with that line under it. Use type number or select for those fields, and validate to refuse a value with a message that shows under the cell. The cell follows value whenever it changes. A mouse starts an edit with a double-click, Enter or F2, and says so on hover; a tap starts it at once on a touch screen.
